YouTube Description Generator

Generate a structured, SEO-friendly YouTube video description from your video details.

Description





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter your video title and main topic.
  2. Add the key points covered and any links.
  3. Add chapters as mm:ss topic lines (optional).
  4. Generate, copy and paste into YouTube Studio.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How does it work?
Enter your video title, topic, key points and links — the tool assembles a formatted description with hook, timestamps placeholders, links and hashtags.
Is it optimized for YouTube SEO?
Yes — the first 2–3 lines are your hook (what shows before 'show more'), with keywords woven in naturally for search.
Can it add chapters?
List them in the chapters field as 'mm:ss topic' and they are formatted as clickable chapters.
How do I use the result?
Click Copy Description and paste it into YouTube Studio.
